h1: Does Massachusetts state law require parking for an ADU?
title: Massachusetts ADU Parking Rules: Transit Distance and Local Requirements
description: Learn the state parking limit for one protected ADU in a single-family residential district and when no additional space may be required.
short_answer: Massachusetts law limits a municipality to requiring no more than one additional parking space for a single ADU in a single-family residential zoning district. No additional space may be required when the ADU is within 0.5 miles of a commuter rail station, subway station, ferry terminal, or bus station. Newton's local rules and the property's transit distance must still be checked.

facts.text: Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 40A, Section 3 limits required additional parking for one ADU and removes the additional-space requirement within the specified half-mile transit distance.
The state ADU regulation makes the protected ADU subject to otherwise applicable dimensional and parking requirements within the limits of state law.

qa.q: Can Newton require an extra ADU parking space within half a mile of transit?
qa.a: State law says no additional parking space may be required for the protected ADU when it is within 0.5 miles of one of the listed transit facilities.
